title: Referral funnel
description: Customer-statement referrals and accountant-client invitations, grouped by source and campaign.
privacyDescription: Recipient contacts and raw IP or user-agent data are never included in this dashboard contract.
preparedLinksDetail: Attribution records created when a delivery or invitation is queued. They do not prove delivery, receipt or a visit.
clicksDetail: Stored redirect events. Requests with the same hashed client metadata are deduplicated per link and UTC day; these are not unique people.
registrationsDetail: Organization-registration events linked to referrals. They do not prove verified accounts, paid subscriptions or completed onboarding.
acceptedInvitationsDetail: Invitations with a recorded acceptance state, counted once each. Historical acceptance does not establish currently active access.
noEvidence: No attribution records were found in this organization. This does not establish that all referral activity was captured.
tableLabel: Recorded referral counts by source and campaign
